sources.citation: Monsy, Annie. 1997. The linguistic significance of Mannan dialect [part 1]. International Journal of Dravidian Linguistics 26(1): 9-38. (Glottolog ref 182204 mis-cites this as 24(2): 105-144; Linguistic Bibliography 2003 p. 1278 and the ISDL Silver Jubilee review give 26/1: 9-38 and 26/2: 105-144.)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Phonology pp. 20-38 covers vowels, consonants, length, 'Supra Segmentals' (junctures open/close, pitch low/mid/high, terminals rising/falling/suspense, intonation), syllable structure, clusters, phonological processes; stress/accent never mentioned. Part 1 ends '[to be continued]' on p. 38 after the phonology, so part 2 (26(2): 105-144) is morphology/comparative and unlikely to add a stress statement.
Stub; nothing on phonology; cites only Ethnologue.
